SUSTAINED_SHIFT.meaning: the one-sided CUSUM (Page) of the node's standardised pre-transform chi-square is above h (DEGRADED), or advanced this tick and is at or below h (NOMINAL): a sustained upward shift in the residuals of the physical relations the node takes part in. It does not say which sensor or component failed.

not_covered.baro: clean-arm sigma0 is degenerate (0.0 over 1500 ticks)
not_covered.imu0: no per-IMU physics chi-square exists in this construction
not_covered.imu1: no per-IMU physics chi-square exists in this construction

expected_inputs: per node (lam, gate) from the frozen v1.1 comparator
fault_behavior: an alarm persists while S stays above h; the statistic is neither advanced nor reset on an inactive tick
health_rule: VALID when the statistic advanced this tick; UNAVAILABLE when the node's input was gated out or not fresh (the frozen bank does not advance it); FAULTED if the statistic is not a finite non-negative number
lineage_rule: the node, every partner it shares a v1 relation with, and each relation's model (csia/trust_graph/graph.py EDGES)
